exposure: Perioperative management (mechanical bowel preparation, type of mesh, type of mesh fixation)
Surgical technique (surgical approach: robotic vs. laparoscopic)
cohort: A total of 280 female patients with a mean age of 62 (+- 14) years, undergoing primary ventral mesh rectopexy (VMR) in 14 Flemish hospitals.
finding: The study revealed significant intra- and interhospital variation in preoperative work-up, surgical indications, operative technique, and postoperative management for ventral mesh rectopexy.
